description: This file contains implementation of logging classes related to options logging within the Orleans framework, including ClientOptionsLogger, a specialized logger for client options, and the abstract base class OptionsLogger which manages the actual logging behavior for options with support for multiple formatters.

classes.name: ClientOptionsLogger
classes.description: Logger for options on the client, implements ILifecycleParticipant to participate in client lifecycle events.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the logger to the client lifecycle so it can log options on startup.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Logs the options when the client lifecycle participant's start event is invoked.

classes.name: OptionsLogger
classes.description: Abstract base class providing logging functionality for options, supporting multiple formatters.

methods.name: LogOptions
methods.description: Logs all options using registered formatters.

methods.name: LogOptions(IEnumerable<IOptionFormatter>)
methods.description: Logs options with supplied formatters, ordered by formatter name.

methods.name: LogOption
methods.description: Logs a single option using a specified formatter.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Allows the logger to participate in lifecycle events, subscribing itself for start events.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Trigger to log options at startup.

methods.name: LogOptions
methods.description: Logs all options using registered formatters in the base class.

methods.name: LogOptions(IEnumerable<IOptionFormatter>)
methods.description: Logs options with a provided set of formatters.

methods.name: LogOption
methods.description: Logs an individual option formatter's data.
